Wāhine in Innovation: Research Scientist Natasha Evans on Green Chemistry, Plastics & Polymers

Natasha Evans, Senior Research Scientist at Callaghan Innovation, speaks about her role in Green Chemistry, Biopolymers and Sustainable Materials for our latest video series ‘Wāhine in Innovation’.

‘Wāhine in Innovation’ aims to profile some of the incredible wāhine (woman) innovators at Callaghan Innovation, shining a spotlight on their achievements and inspiring the next generation of female scientists, engineers, entrepreneurs, and innovators.

Subscribe to our channel for more!
